comment: Read at commit 1fc62fa, the only commit carrying the installed 2.0.4. The nine rows pass the signal through untouched but drop every channel beyond the first, so the module is not transparent to polyphonic cables. The line at LessMess.cpp:43 guards the copy on the input being connected, so an output whose input is pulled out freezes at its last value rather than falling to 0V. The nine rows carry whatever is patched through them, so none of the eighteen jacks is given a family.
